source_pages: CS-80 service BA27/BA28, MKB63, S31-S38; engineering alternatives documented in docs/workstreams/ws6-library.md
rationale: A memory or PANEL source must preserve the same 26-row addresses, selected-supply semantics, unbuffered wiper loading and diode isolation already checked against the standalone double-precision Newton truth model. The existing memory_panel_v1 bus/current/residual limits are copied unchanged, not relaxed. Pot position tolerances cover only float host-parameter quantisation and inverted JUCE NormalisableRange skew; they are not hardware slider tolerances.

memory_panel_audio_input_v1.switch_rows: exact logical pulse/saw identity; no analogue voltage tolerance
memory_panel_audio_input_v1.scope: both ranks, selector 11/12/13, schematic outputs 1..26 except waveform switch rows 4/5, inverse physical-parameter skew; no Engine path or factory V1 numerics modified
